run_ade_dosage_preprocessing: run the AdeCorpusV2_Dosage module to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_ade_corpus_dataset: create an AdeCorpusV2_Dosage dataset instance to load the ADE drug dosage relation dataset
load_ade_corpus_v2: load the ADE corpus v2 drug dosage relation dataset from Hugging Face datasets
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of text-drug and dosage tuples
split_train_test_lines: split the ADE corpus dataset into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets
